ssim_method: Channel-average SSIM over the union of source/render foreground pixels (alpha > 0.5), using uniform 7x7 local windows, C1=0.01^2, C2=0.03^2. Original pixel dimensions. This is a defined image-similarity check, not a guarantee of subjective equivalence.
notes: Original PNG and previous SVG preserved. Merged close solid-colour tones into 512 groups and rebuilt their shared contours as continuous regions; kept the main 480 fitted gradients and the approved silhouette. Preserved the integer-coordinate scale when optimizing markup. The conservative Bezier fitting trial produced no worthwhile savings and was not used. A 0.1px seam-correction effect remains. This is still a detailed vector trace.
